## 提交前 / Checklist

- [ ] 已阅读贡献指南与行为准则 / I read the contributing guide and code of conduct.
- [ ] 修改聚焦本次问题，未混入无关文件 / Changes are scoped to this problem.
- [ ] 已移除密钥、私人数据与日志中的敏感内容 / Sensitive information is removed.
- [ ] 已记录验证结果及未运行的检查 / Validation and omitted checks are documented.
- [ ] 已按需更新文档 / Relevant documentation is updated.
